_readme: Camera path for 3d-tour-test.html, textured model (plaza-textured.glb). space:'meta' = plaza-textured-meta.json coords: glTF Y-up, metres, model centred on x/z with the lowest point at y=0 (so scene space == meta space). pos = camera position, look = aim point. Exterior flythrough: SE wide -> south approach -> plaza at eye level -> up the tower -> over the roof -> around N and W -> SW wide.
